scope: Immutable synthetic wire-v1 consumer normalization, not API32/PG acceptance

results.case: Wire bootstrap retains explicit profiles and no implicit source selection
A self-reported ACK keeps numeric units/provenance and does not derive absent lean mass
Personal pages normalize only the exact selected profile and server range
No notes, unexpected units or duplicate record IDs are accepted into a personal page
Native legacy history retains unknown measurement date and cannot become editable
A legacy row may not acquire a measurement date from its recording timestamp
Own consent discovery has only minimal events and explicit withdrawal capabilities
OWNER metadata exception permits withdrawal without effective scope or grant
No prior event is virtual zero without inventing a grant, profile or withdrawable row
Retirement ACK is a new event and cannot be presented as active sharing
Consent future date range remains independent from bounded observed data queries
Professional projection preserves exact link/consent identity and selected numeric fields
Unselected body-fat, raw diary and stale consent identity reject the complete projection
A false current read capability cannot be turned into authority by a matching payload
Corrupt observed counts reject the whole projection instead of returning partial health values
